text:
Type: red metal stacking stool
Use: extra seating, quick perch, plant stand; dining room, kitchen, home office, hallway
Style: retro, modern, minimalist
Materials: red powder-coated steel legs, molded plastic seat with round holes
Colors: bright red
Shape: round flat seat dotted with round holes, four straight slim tube legs angling slightly outward, stackable, compact and light
Feel: playful, bold, casual, cheerful
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black accents, colorful decor; retro, modern or playful kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: MARIUS
product.description: The stool can be stacked, so you can keep several on hand and store them on the same space as one.
